candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(smartfix_owner == msg.sender) access-control check so anyone can trigger selfdestruct.
Change the require condition to smartfix_owner != msg.sender so the check is inverted and non-owners (who are not the owner at deployment) can selfdestruct.
Remove the selfdestruct statement so the function no longer destroys the contract or sends its balance.
Redirect the selfdestruct payout to the contract owner instead of the caller.
